title: Not following the template and ID conventions (I1)
planted_problem: Three conformance problems: the ID FR-003 is used twice, one requirement uses a different ID format (REQ-5), and the mandatory Success Criteria section is replaced by a non-template 'Goals' section.

expected_findings.evidence: Any member MUST be able to mark an item as bought.
expected_findings.expected_issue: FR-003 is assigned to two different requirements
one requirement uses REQ-5 instead of the FR-### format
the Spec Kit template's Success Criteria section is missing; a non-template Goals section is used instead

must_not_flag.reason: sub-lettered IDs are an allowed convention for split requirements

forbidden_revision_behaviors: deleting one of the two FR-003 requirements
inventing success criteria values (numbers, percentages, times)
expected_revision_behavior: the second FR-003 gets a new unused ID; REQ-5 gets an FR-### ID; a Success Criteria section is added with [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] instead of invented targets
